gaps: The excerpt documents only the MOUNTING STRUCTURE. A '3 kWp ... installation' dataset also contains the photovoltaic panel/laminate (Tab. 5.1.8.2.x, pages outside this range), the inverter (Tab. 5.6.1.3/5.6.1.4) and the electric installation, none of which can be read here.

The table is per m2 of panel area; the excerpt gives no module efficiency, so the m2 per 3 kWp had to be taken from a standard module power density. Every amount carries that scaling uncertainty (the bounds correspond to roughly 15 to 27 m2 per 3 kWp).
No direct emissions and no land use for the roof variants (the Transformation and Occupation rows are '-' for every roof column; they apply only to open-ground constructions).
The table is European (RER) data while the BAFU dataset is [APAC] resp. [CH].
